Package com.github.query4j.optimizer.index

Class IndexSuggestion

java.lang.Object
com.github.query4j.optimizer.index.IndexSuggestion
public final class IndexSuggestion extends Object
Immutable suggestion for database index creation to improve query performance. Includes metadata about the index type, columns, and expected performance benefit.
